title: Morphology-guided deep learning for nanoparticle agglomeration diagnostic assays.
summary: Morphology-guided Mc-GNN classifies single-particle image crops to predict Target-DNA/Viral-RNA concentration in nanoparticle agglomeration assays; reported Target-DNA F1 is 0.9814. Targets are assay materials, not clinical patient samples.
ai_technology: Morphology-guided Mc-GNN classifies single-particle image crops to predict Target-DNA/Viral-RNA concentration in nanoparticle agglomeration assays; reported Target-DNA F1 is 0.9814. Targets are assay materials, not clinical patient samples.

evidence.tested: Cross-fold comparisons, classical/deep-learning baselines and ablations support assay proof-of-concept; no clinical sensitivity is established.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed source does not establish prospective benefit, broad external validity, or replication beyond the reported study.
